simple.meaning: זָקֵן (zâqên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “old.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 179 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 18:11. Its contexts include family, family line, death, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָקֵן (H2205).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זָקֵן (zâqên) / H2205 is traced through Genesis 18:11, Genesis 19:4, Genesis 24:2, Genesis 25:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.
